title: Open problem: Extended states for the three-dimensional Anderson model at weak disorder
body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). Prove existence of absolutely continuous spectrum (delocalised states) for the random Schrodinger operator -Delta + lambda V on Z^3 at small disorder lambda, and GOE local statistics for its finite-volume restriction. Source: Bourgade: Random band matrices, ICM 2018 survey, Section 2.1, p. 7.
Posed in Bourgade: Random band matrices, ICM 2018 survey
Current status unverified as of 2026-09-07

title: Attempt on Extended states for the three-dimensional Anderson model at weak disorder
body:
ATTEMPT RECORD, author-checked only, from the 2026-09-07 intake. Method: Review the failure of perturbation theory and test a restricted version on a tree-like subgraph. Result: On the Bethe lattice a.c. spectrum is known (Klein; Aizenman-Warzel) because the self-consistent equation for the Green function has a stable solution; on Z^3 the corresponding equation is not closed. A known partial statement is that the disorder-averaged Green function has diffusive behaviour up to times lambda^{-2-delta} (Erdos-Salmhofer-Yau), which is the kinetic regime and does not reach the infinite-time statement. I tested the possibility of transferring the tree result through a spanning tree of Z^3: the operator restricted to a spanning tree is not the operator on Z^3, and removing the edges changes the spectrum non-perturbatively, so no transfer. No result; the problem is recorded as attempted with the explicit obstruction that the only tools proving a.c. spectrum are tree-specific. Obstruction: Absence of a closed self-consistency equation on Z^3; kinetic-regime results stop at finite times.
Refers to the open problem node open-problem-c0056-extended-states-for-the-three-dimensional-anderson-model-at-weak-disor
No independent review; result status attempted_unsolved

title: Anderson model (random Schrodinger operators)
body: The random Schrodinger operator $H=-\Delta+\lambda V$ on $\mathbb Z^d$ with i.i.d. potential $V$; it has localization (pure point spectrum with exponentially decaying eigenfunctions) at large disorder and at band edges, while extended states are conjectured for $d\ge3$ at weak disorder; random band matrices interpolate between it and Wigner matrices.
